tagline: Every patient, every stage, in one view.

accent.name: Signal Cyan
accent.role: signature brand accent (not the primary action color; slate #0F172B stays the action color)

type.wordmark: Geist SemiBold (outlined in the logo files)

accessibility.method: CIELAB dE76 with Machado full-severity CVD simulation (protan/deutan/tritan)
accessibility.note: Accent clears every clinical stage & triage color at dE >= 11.7 under common (red-green) CVD. The one soft near-neighbor is the muted Discharge-planning grey #90A1B9 (a non-triage stage tint); the accent is always high-chroma cyan while that color is desaturated, and the accent never appears as a clinical chip.
